description: issue #851: `set_shape "circle"` - `"circle"` is one of the four portable shape words that `spec/rendering.md` now requires every implementation to support (MUST, raised from SHOULD), so it is accepted, updates `turtle.shape` from the default `"turtle"`, and emits `shape-change` ({from: "turtle", to: "circle"}) with no diagnostic. With `set-shape-basic` (`"triangle"`), `set-shape-arrow`, and `set-shape-turtle` (which passes `"turtle"` as an argument rather than relying on it being the default), all four portable words are pinned as ACCEPTED under this profile. Rendering them DISTINCTLY is a separate, renderer-owned property that this event stream cannot observe - it records only the accepted word - and lives in `@openlogo/turtle` (`canvas.test.mjs`: "'turtle' and 'triangle' shapes render distinct outlines", "arrow shape draws its four-point outline").
